_readme: Machine-checkable removal triggers for SYSTEM.md §13 (Active migrations & deprecation ledger). SYSTEM.md remains the source of truth for WHY each row exists and its traps; this file only encodes the triggers that can be evaluated mechanically. Run: python3 ~/.claude/skills/ai-slop-detector/scripts/ledger_check.py .  (add --strict for a non-zero exit on drift). Rows without triggers are prose/DB/build conditions — verify those by hand per SYSTEM.md. Keep row ids identical to §13.

job_search_brief's identically named response fields are a frozen outward projection, NOT a legacy reader — deliberately outside the trigger paths. Also requires the Settings editor legacy bridge gone and GET /api/settings/autofill clean. Trigger paths are DIRECTORIES, not files: extension/content/ was widened 2026-08-02 after the phase-2 split moved the dual-read out of agent.js, and extension/panel/ was added after the panel's workAuthForWrite (actions/pause.js) turned out to promote the legacy pair before the first typed pause-row write while the content-only path read green. A file-pinned path goes green on the next rename without the reader dying.
No reader of jobs.location may remain (JobSummary still exposes only the old field), then op.drop_column.
